name: Local model served by vLLM (2x H100)
description: Serves nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-NVFP4, text only, across two H100 80 GB GPUs: a released vLLM with prebuilt FlashInfer kernels in /opt/vllm, the CUDA 13.0 toolkit FlashInfer compiles one kernel with, and the script that downloads the weights and starts the server. Debian-based images on x86_64 with an NVIDIA driver 580 or newer.

username.description: Username of the container user. The server runs as this user at start-up (start-vllm.sh).

userHomeDir.description: Home directory of the container user: where the weights, caches and log live (APP_USER_HOME at run time).
